model: Expected-goals ratings model (v1.1): team offense/defense ratings fitted walk-forward on MoneyPuck expected goals, a 0.20-goal home-ice term, a rest-day term, Poisson win probabilities, and a calibration map fitted on the discovery period (a=-0.0279, b=1.2755). The betting line is never an input — only the benchmark. Moneyline picks publish when model and market disagree by 2.0 points or more; totals are context only.

shadow_seed.label: Pre-launch shadow record
shadow_seed.note: Before this section launched, the model ran in shadow for 16 nights: picks frozen before puck drop, graded against official finals, nothing published. That frozen record is the seed of this track record — shown in full, including the one excluded game below. On the 104 games that froze with a valid market line, model and market are an effective tie (calibrated Brier 0.2312 vs 0.2304). The model has not beaten the market and no edge is claimed.

excluded_game.reason: The game froze with an invalid market moneyline: -1.0 across all 8 books, a 1.8% implied home win chance for a home favorite. That single bad feed value would flatter the model in every market comparison, so the game is excluded from all of them. The frozen shadow record itself is unchanged.
excluded_game.model_line: Model-only, counted in full: the model had Anaheim at 46.8% raw / 45.2% calibrated — it picked Ottawa, and Ottawa lost 6-3. The miss counts in the model's own numbers; only the market comparison excludes the game.
